test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Europe

2. Madrid 

3. World

4. Spain

5. Universe
solution:
The correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order is:

 
• Madrid is the capital city of Spain.
 
• Spain is a Country in Europe.
 
• Europe is one of the seven continents of the world.&l
